content: This division addressed land used for the husband's business, an Audi Q2, and a salary-fed bank account. Assets intended for an enterprise formed during the marriage fall into the comunione de residuo under Art. 178 CC if they survive dissolution, distinguishing them from "professional" assets under Art. 179 CC which require a spousal declaration for exclusion. For bank accounts, cointestation only creates a presumption of equal ownership; if one spouse proves the funds consist solely of their salary, the other's withdrawal constitutes an undue appropriation (indebito). Consequently, the husband was ordered to return €16,000 withdrawn from the wife’s salary-funded account.
